functions.name: models
functions.purpose: Discover credential-visible hosted models before selecting an inference target.

functions.name: chat
functions.purpose: Run explicit hosted-model inference experiments with exact provider/model identity.

functions.name: embeddings
functions.purpose: Generate query/passage embeddings for ClayGraph retrieval, clustering and retrieval benchmarks.

functions.name: rerank
functions.purpose: Rerank candidate evidence/passages and test structured retrieval quality independently from the LLM reader.

security_rule: Load NVIDIA_API_KEY only at runtime through rae_secret_loader; never copy credential values into requests, results, logs, packets, claims or reports.
routing_rule: Use model catalog before selecting a named hosted model. Prefer NVIDIA embeddings/reranking when retrieval quality is a variable; keep reader-model effects separate from retriever/reranker effects. Hosted NVIDIA results do not substitute for local hardware latency, memory, energy or thermal evidence.
